item.title: Trump wanted retribution in Indiana. Primary results show he can still deliver it
'The rats are like a storm': Palestinians seeking refuge in rubble struggle with rodent infestations
item.summary: Palestinians living in tents amid the rubble in the Gaza Strip and aid groups trying to help them say rodent infestations have left them suffering from diseases and unsure how to cope.

item.title: Trump pauses U.S. effort to guide vessels through Strait of Hormuz in bid to make deal with Iran
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump says that he has paused the U.S. effort to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz to finalize an Iran deal.

item.title: Prosecutors add assault charge to case against suspect in White House press gala shooting
item.summary: The U.S. Justice Department on Tuesday added ‌a charge of assault on a federal officer with a deadly weapon to the case ​against the man accused of ​trying to assassinate President Donald Trump at the White House correspondents' ​dinner in Washington, D.C., last month.

item.title: He was teaching CPR, then went into cardiac arrest. His students saved him
item.summary: Karl Arps was demonstrating the signs of a heart attack during a training course when he really had one, and went into cardiac arrest.

item.title: The Kremlin has been throttling the internet and blaming security threats. Many Russians aren't buying it
item.summary: In Moscow, residents have experienced multiple internet outages recently, which have made it impossible to use the mobile web. The government says the measures are necessary for security, but many see it as part of the Kremlin's tightening grip on the country's digital space.

item.title: Canada and Europe should get ‘creative’ in forging closer ties, EU ambassador says
item.summary: The EU’s Ambassador to Canada, Geneviève Tuts, says the bloc is looking to "elevate" its relationship with this country and take it to the "next level."

item.title: Human-to-human transmission of killer hantavirus suspected in cruise ship outbreak
item.summary: After a spate of deaths and illnesses stemming from a hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship, health officials now suspect human-to-human transmission may have played a role in the spread of this potentially deadly infection. So what's the risk to broader public health?

item.title: Mexico moved extradition goalposts after U.S. indicted top politician over cartel ties: experts
item.summary: The Claudia Sheinbaum administration's demand for "irrefutable" proof before handing over a top elected politician to the U.S. over alleged drug cartel dealings reveals how the Mexican government applies a double standard in its stated battle against organized crime, experts say.

item.title: U.S. rights group sues New York Times, claiming discrimination against a white man
item.summary: A U.S. federal civil rights agency filed a discrimination lawsuit Tuesday against the New York Times, claiming that the news organization passed over a white male employee for a promotion in favour of a lesser qualified woman to meet its diversity goals.
